[[Knights of San Fernando]] |TV actor =See [[#Behind the scenes|below]] }} '''Aspirants''' are characters in the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]]. ==Background== {{main|Brotherhood of Steel hierarchy}} In the [[Brotherhood of Steel]] chapter known as the [[Knights of San Fernando]], aspirants are low-ranking Brotherhood trainees, which seems to include both children and older adult trainees. Aside from many unnamed aspirants, they include [[Maximus]], [[Dane (TV series)|Dane]], and [[Thaddeus]] (all of whom are eventually promoted to [[squire (TV series)|squire]]), as well as [[Thaddeus' minion|Thaddeus' five minions]] and the [[young aspirant]]. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===Season 1=== ====[[The End (episode)|The End]]==== The Brotherhood is introduced with a cut to [[Thaddeus' minion|several aspirants]] in white T-shirts in the desert, all beating a peer into the dirt. The victim, [[Maximus]], becomes the perspective character; when they're done with Maximus, [[Dane (TV series)|Dane]] approaches Maximus and tries to console the beaten-up Maximus. As they head off, several other aspirants are seen performing their daily duties. Afterward, within the Brotherhood of Steel airbase hanger, [[Felix (TV series)|Cleric Felix]] teaches the studious aspirants their purpose of becoming a [[Squire (TV series)|squire]] to a [[Brotherhood_of_Steel_ranks#Knights|knight]] of the [[Brotherhood of Steel]]. He's shown to act in a physically disciplinary way when Maximus gets an answer wrong that he asked. Just then, [[the Prydwen|the ''Prydwen'']] arrives, drawing the attention of the aspirants there, and watching as the knights in their [[T-60 power armor]] arrive. Maximus wondered why they were there and would later perform latrine duties until Dane stopped him and took him to the hangar where the T-60 power armor suits were at. Maximus was enamored by it until [[Brotherhood soldier (TV series)|officers]] [[Shortsight]] and another had business with Dane. Early the next morning, several aspirants are seen tossing cement scraps into a makeshift basketball hoop. Inside the cabins for the aspirants, some aspirants were seen preparing themselves as Maximus woke up and saw a commotion outside made by his fellow aspirants. There, Maximus learns that Dane was one of the many anointed to squire. As Dane and his fellow aspirants follow him into a cabin, Maximus despondently watches him. That night, Maximus overhears many of his peers talk about who will be anointed next, and has a meltdown over it. The next day, Maximus, Thaddeus and his fellow aspirants awaken to the sound of Dane screaming in pain to learn that someone placed a razor blade in their boot. Ultimately, Maximus is blamed for the incident and is taken into questioning for it. While being led to his interrogation, some aspirants were seen performing physical combat training against each other. [[Quintus|Elder Cleric Quintus]] interrogates Maximus over the plausibility of being a suspect for Dane's injury and, in the end, passes Dane's anointment to him and assigns him to [[Titus|Knight Titus]]. When Maximus visits Dane in the infirmary, an injured aspirant is seen lying on a cot. Dane and Maximus talk to each other, and when asked who Dane suspects injured them, they answer that they've narrowed it down to Thaddeus and his cohorts. Eventually, some aspirants, including Thaddeus, sit in observation of Maximus' anointment ceremony. Later, aspirants are seen in the multi-single file crowds where Elder Cleric Quintis announces to the knights and their newly appointed squires their task. It involved hunting a [[Enclave]] member with a [[Cold fusion|dangerous device]] in his possession. Paper copies of the target are passed around by Thaddeus and one of his minions. Once the speech was over and the papers with the targets were passed around, the aspirants watched as the knights and their respective squires headed off. ===Season 2=== ====[[The Golden Rule]]==== They cheer on [[Maximus]] during his fight with the [[Coronado knight]]. ====[[The Profligate]]==== They can be seen working outside the [[Area 51]] base. ====[[The Demon in the Snow]]==== They are placed in a safe room before fighting start to break out between the elders from the three chapters, and Maximus' showdown with [[Quintus]]. ==Appearances== The aspirants appear only {{in|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|1=101|10=202|11=203|12=204}} ==Behind the scenes== * On Prime Video, the character overview page for the ''Fallout'' TV series calls Thaddeus and Dane ''Initiates'' of the Brotherhood rather than aspirants (Thaddeus in the [[Fallout season 1 Amazon overview|overviews for both season 1]] and [[Fallout season 2 Amazon overview|season 2]], and Dane in the overview for season 1).[[Fallout season 1 Amazon overview]]; Thaddeus: ''An Initiate of the Brotherhood of Steel and a consummate bully, Thaddeus takes advantage of Maximus’s perceived weakness and uses him as a means to build up his own confidence and perceived toughness.''[[Fallout season 2 Amazon overview]]; Thaddeus: ''Once an Initiate of the Brotherhood of Steel and a bully with his sights set on Maximus, Thaddeus has since undergone some serious transformation (both figuratively and LITERALLY).''[[Fallout season 1 Amazon overview]]; Dane: ''Dane is a confident and eager Initiate of the Brotherhood of Steel, and Maximus’s closest peer. They believe in the mission of the Brotherhood and dream of one day suiting up as a Knight.'' However, there is no other mention of the term "initiate" anywhere else in the series, nor in the [[The End script|script for "The End,"]] where all of the relevant characters are called aspirants instead. In general, the Knights of San Fernando seem to use the rank of aspirant as its equivalent for the ranks of initiate and squire in other previously seen chapters. * Unnamed aspirants are portrayed by stunt performers and uncredited extras. ;Uncredited extras * [[Ryan Cho]] ("[[The Golden Rule]]" and "[[The Profligate]]") * [[Dave Magtoto]] ("The Golden Rule" and "The Profligate") ==Gallery== FoTV Aspirant Golden Rule Magtoto.png|Played by [[Dave Magtoto]] ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]] [[Category:Brotherhood of Steel characters]]
